summary: Several dependencies can live in one parameter step and act independently, e.g. showAdvanced reveals maxSyncDelay while serviceRestart 'Yes' reveals a restartReason field with minLength 10 and a custom errorMessage. Each dependencies key matches a property in the same step.
questions: Can I have multiple dynamic dependencies in one template step?
How do I require a reason with a minimum length when a user picks Yes?
How do I set a custom validation error message in a template field?
